title: AI Governance InternationaL Evaluation Index (AGILE Index) 2024
reasoning: The paper focuses on the development and application of an AI governance index which explicitly evaluates ethical components, including AI principles and norms (Dimension 8), AI ethics assessment tools (Dimension 9), and analyzes literature based on ethical topics like fairness and transparency. It was co-developed by the International Research Center for AI Ethics and Governance.
